title: Card delivery pack
slide_intent: Carry recognition into the moment of receiving a product because packaging is part of the service experience.
strategic_value: The green card, personal greeting and large slogan can make Wise’s arrival feel both recognizable and addressed to one person.
demonstration: An open card pack sits on a curved teal surface; a dark flap carries stacked green copy and the pale insert holds the card beneath a personal greeting.
practical_value: Compare the roles of expressive packaging copy and practical delivery information.

content_islands.name: Outer flap
content_islands.spec: Set stacked green copy on the dark left flap.

content_islands.name: Card insert
content_islands.spec: Place the card on the pale right insert beneath the personal greeting, with small instructions below.

content_islands.name: Photographic setting
content_islands.spec: Retain the curved teal support and directional shadow.

reference_purposes.Expression: An open card pack sits on a curved teal surface; a dark flap carries stacked green copy and the pale insert holds the card beneath a personal greeting.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates a complete card-delivery pack.
